```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The group voted overwhelmingly at its national convention to adopt resolutions in defense of disability rights and prison abolition.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The group must take its stances on disability rights and prison abolition to their natural conclusion by fighting to abolish systems that segregate disabled people from society.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The group must advocate for the expansion of disability benefits.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The group must advocate for the end of sub-minimum wage authorizations.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The group must advocate for the availability of universal, meaningful jobs for all, including disabled people.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The group must enact a comprehensive plan for healthcare justice that recognizes that community-based care is both the means and ends of its organizing.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"For disabled people to participate fully in society, they must be able to receive the care and support they need in their communities, not in institutions.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The group will fight alongside members of ADAPT by opposing separatist legislation like H.R. 620.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The group will support legislation compatible with its inclusionary socialist vision for the future, like the Disability Integration Act (S. 910).",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The group recognizes that it is disability liberation or barbarism.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
